description: Associates a human gene with a Gene Ontology cellular component through direct NCBI gene2go annotation or inference from an annotated descendant term.

common_properties.name: qualifier
common_properties.description: Annotation qualifiers from NCBI gene2go; propagated associations without direct annotation use ["inferred"].
common_properties.notes: The `qualifier` and `evidence` lists are positionally aligned — `qualifier[i]` corresponds to `evidence[i]`, representing one distinct annotation row from gene2go. Only unique (qualifier, evidence) pairs are stored per edge; duplicates arising from different PubMed support are collapsed.

common_properties.name: evidence
common_properties.description: GO evidence codes from NCBI gene2go, such as IDA, IEA, IBA, TAS, and IMP; propagated associations without direct annotation use ["inferred"].

common_properties.name: unbiased
common_properties.description: Always False: GO annotations are a curated (biased) set.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data source for the association; always ["NCBI gene2go"].

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the association was last created or updated.

source_contributions.scope: Human annotations (tax_id = 9606) for genes present in SPOKE and non-obsolete cellular component terms whose final annotated-gene sets contain 2–1000 genes, inclusive. All non-NOT qualifiers are included. A gene with a NOT annotation to a term is excluded from that term, including inferred associations.
source_contributions.description: Includes direct annotations and associations inherited through GO is_a and part_of relationships. Direct support takes precedence when an association is also inferred: only the direct qualifier/evidence pairs are recorded, without the "inferred" sentinel.
